name: ADA service counter, 48 in
clearanceBasis: ASSUMPTION (not a code determination): front 0.91 m, sides 0.0 m, back 0.0 m. Front 0.91 m = ADA 36 in minimum clear width of an accessible route (2010 ADA Standards 403.5.1).

provenance.origin: ADA 904.4 service counter class (top 36 in max; 48 in long section at 34 in high, 1.22 x 0.61 x 0.86 m)
provenance.notes: Lowered section so every customer can reach the register or hand-off; ADA 904.4.1 requires a 36 in (0.91 m) long section at most 36 in high. Dimensions are a class estimate, not a measurement; replace with a spec sheet or tape measure before purchase.
